items.exampleEn: The village has remained unchanged for a hundred years.
items.exampleZh: 這個村子一百年來都沒有改變。

items.exampleEn: The baby cried endlessly during the long flight.
items.exampleZh: 長途飛行中，那個嬰兒哭個不停。

items.exampleEn: The ticket became worthless after the concert was cancelled.
items.exampleZh: 演唱會取消後，那張票就變得一文不值。

items.exampleEn: The young player showed signs of greatness at the age of twelve.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕選手十二歲時就展現出卓越的潛質。

items.exampleEn: It was rash of him to spend all his money on one painting.
items.exampleZh: 他把所有的錢都花在一幅畫上，真是太輕率了。

items.exampleEn: A good dictionary is indispensable for translators.
items.exampleZh: 一本好字典對翻譯者來說不可或缺。

items.exampleEn: The car has luxurious leather seats.
items.exampleZh: 那輛車有豪華的真皮座椅。

items.exampleEn: The offer of a free trip was irresistible.
items.exampleZh: 免費旅遊的提議讓人無法抗拒。

items.sentenceEn: Prices at the night market were unchanged this week.
items.sentenceZh: 這週夜市的價格沒有變動。

items.audioEn: The hotel was luxurious, but the food was disappointing, so we ate outside every night.
items.audioZh: 那間飯店很豪華，但食物令人失望，所以我們每晚都在外面吃。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼每晚都在外面吃？

items.sentenceEn: My phone has become indispensable in my daily life.
items.sentenceZh: 手機已經成為我日常生活中不可或缺的東西。

items.sentenceEn: The puppy's big brown eyes were simply irresistible.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻小狗棕色的大眼睛真是讓人無法抗拒。

items.stemEn: Cutting your own hair the night before the wedding was a ____ decision.
items.stemZh: 婚禮前一晚自己剪頭髮，真是個輕率的決定。

items.stemEn: These old coins are ____; nobody wants to buy them.
items.stemZh: 這些舊硬幣一文不值，沒有人想買。

items.passageEn: When my grandfather turned eighty, we took him to a luxurious hotel by the sea. At dinner, he talked endlessly about his first job, but we didn't mind. He spoke affectionately about his father's old watch, which looked worthless but was the most precious thing he owned, because it reminded him of home. He also said that true greatness is not about money but about kindness. The hotel's chocolate cake was irresistible, and he ate three pieces.
items.passageZh: 爺爺八十歲生日時，我們帶他去海邊一間豪華飯店。晚餐時，他滔滔不絕地講起他的第一份工作，但我們一點也不介意。他充滿感情地談起他父親的那支舊錶，看起來不值錢，卻是他擁有的東西中最珍貴的，因為它讓他想起家鄉。他還說，真正的偉大不在於金錢，而在於善良。飯店的巧克力蛋糕讓人無法抗拒，他一口氣吃了三塊。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺為什麼覺得那支舊錶最重要？
爺爺認為真正的偉大在於什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們不應該只根據一則新聞就做出輕率的判斷。
referenceEn: We shouldn't make a rash judgment based on one news story.
We should not make rash judgments from just one news report.
rubricZh: 要用 rash（例如 a rash judgment、rash decisions、be rash 等）
「根據」可寫，例如 based on、from 等
「不應該」可寫，例如 shouldn't、should not 等

items.instructionZh: 用 indispensable 造一個句子，說說一樣你生活中不可或缺的東西。
referenceEn: My coffee machine is indispensable to me in the morning.
For me, a good pair of shoes is indispensable when I travel.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 indispensable（例如 is indispensable to me）
說出是什麼東西（例如 my coffee machine、a good pair of shoes 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：「looked worthless but was the most indispensable thing he owned, because it reminded him of home」：indispensable 指「不可缺少、必需」，用於有紀念價值的舊錶不自然（應是 precious／treasured）；疑似用法與詞義不符，建議改 indispensable 用在實用物品，或改寫成 he could not live without it…。
